post.description: Creates the local enrollment, then the B2Brouter account, then (by default) activates the DGFiP tax report setting. On provider failure the local enrollment is persisted in `error_account`/`error_activation` state for retries.

get.summary: Look up French company data by SIRET, SIREN or FR VAT number (SIRENE registry)
get.description: Resolves the SIREN from the given identifier and returns official company data from the INSEE SIRENE registry. Rate-limited to 3 requests per minute per user.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: SIRET (14 digits), SIREN (9 digits) or French VAT number (FR + 2 chars + 9 digits)

404.description: No company found for the given SIREN

422.description: Missing or invalid query parameter q

get.summary: Aggregated revenue statistics for e-reporting transactions
get.description: Returns turnover totals, a time series and breakdowns (by transaction type, counterparty country and state) for the authenticated company. Read-only aggregation over the company's transactions. Amounts are computed in the most frequent currency in the range (`primary_currency`); a `by_currency` breakdown and `is_multi_currency` flag surface any other currencies. Defaults to the last 12 months and a monthly interval.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (Y-m-d). Defaults to 12 months ago.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound (Y-m-d). Defaults to today. Must be >= date_from.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Time-series bucket size. Defaults to month.

post.summary: Record and (optionally) submit a Flux 10 transaction
post.description: Persists the transaction locally, then forwards it to the provider as the appropriate B2Brouter invoice type (IssuedSimplifiedInvoice for B2C, IssuedInvoice for outbound, ReceivedInvoice for inbound). Set `submit_now=false` to defer submission.

404.description: Enrollment not found / belongs to another company

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction ID

delete.description: Only transactions in 'pending' state can be deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction ID

422.description: Only pending transactions can be deleted

post.summary: Submit (or retry) an existing transaction to the provider
post.description: Submits a transaction that is in 'pending' or 'error' state to B2Brouter/DGFiP. Replays the invoice lines stored in provider_payload so they don't have to be re-sent. Already-submitted transactions are rejected.

422.description: Transaction already submitted / enrollment not provisioned

post.summary: Bulk import compliance transactions from a CSV file
post.description: Uploads a semicolon-delimited CSV (max 2 MB). Required columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, transaction_type, subtotal, total, line_description, line_quantity, line_price, tax_name, tax_percent, tax_category. Optional columns: due_date, currency, tax_amount, counterparty_name, counterparty_country, counterparty_vat_number. Rows sharing an invoice_number are grouped into one transaction with multiple lines. Duplicates (same invoice natural key) are skipped without error.

404.description: Enrollment not found for this company

422.description: Missing CSV columns / unreadable file / validation failed

post.description: Resolves a company name + address + country to its VAT/UID number with a confidence score. Returns a result synchronously when a confident match is found in your validated data; otherwise responds 202 with a jobId to poll (and delivers the result via the `enrichment.completed` webhook). Requires the Smart Enrichment add-on.

Submits a batch of company records for reverse VAT lookup. Always processed asynchronously: responds 202 with a jobId; per-item results are delivered via the `enrichment.completed` webhook and retrievable via GET /v1/smart-enrichment/{jobId}.

get.description: Returns the current billing-period Smart Enrichment usage: matches used, the included monthly allowance, remaining included matches, the per-match overage price, and the optional hard cap. Usage is counted in successful matches.

history.description: Recent monthly billing for full transparency

get.description: Paginated history of Smart Enrichment lookups for the authenticated company, newest first. Each row is a compact summary (the query and the headline result); full detail is available via GET /v1/smart-enrichment/{jobId}.

Download the authenticated company's Smart Enrichment lookups as a CSV in the bulk-input shape plus resolved VAT columns. Optional filters: date range (created_at), minimum confidence, item status, and only-found.

Aggregated Smart Enrichment statistics for the authenticated company: headline totals (lookups, items, matches, match rate, average confidence), a time series, and breakdowns by source, outcome and confidence band. Read-only. Defaults to the last 12 months and a monthly interval.

post.description: Checks if a VAT UID is valid. If the AI company-name score is near zero and addressLine1 or addressLine2 is provided, Taxora retries scoring with the address line candidate and keeps the better deterministic result.

company_name.description: The company name to validate against the VAT UID

addressLine1.description: Optional first address line. Used as fallback company-name candidate only when company_name scoring is near zero.

provider.description: The VAT provider to use for validation. Possible values: 'fon' (Fon), 'vies' (Vies), 'france_vat' (France VAT), 'anaf' (ANAF), 'uk_hmrc' (UK HMRC), 'ai_search' (AI Search), 'fon_vies_ai_search' (Fon + Vies + AI Search), 'uk_hmrc_ai_search' (UK HMRC + AI Search), 'fon_ai_search' (Fon + AI Search), 'fon_vies' (Fon + Vies), 'vies_ai_search' (Vies + AI Search). Default is null.

fallbackAttemptedPrimaryKept.summary: Sandbox: fallback attempted but primary kept

post.description: Checks if multiple VAT UIDs are valid and returns their validation status.

vat_uids.description: An array of VAT UIDs to validate

provider.description: The VAT provider to use for validation. Default is null.

VatSandboxTestData.title: Sandbox VAT Test Data
VatSandboxTestData.description: Static VAT UIDs available in sandbox and development environments for testing integration flows.

valid_vat_uids.description: VAT numbers that always return a valid response in sandbox/development mode.

invalid_vat_uids.description: VAT numbers that always return an invalid response in sandbox/development mode.

notes.description: Additional guidance for consumers using the sandbox test UIDs.
notes.example: Use these VAT numbers when calling /v1/vat/validate or /v1/vat/validate-multiple in sandbox or development environments to receive deterministic mock responses. Address fallback simulator examples: ATU44000001 returns Fallback Line One Trading GmbH, Testgasse 11, 1020 Wien, AT; send company_name=John Doe plus addressLine1=Fallback Line One Trading GmbH and the sandbox will force a zero primary company_name score and a winning addressLine1 fallback, so requested_company_name becomes Fallback Line One Trading GmbH and score_source=addressLine1Fallback. DE440000002 returns Fallback Line Two Systems GmbH, Musterstrasse 22, 20095 Hamburg, DE; send company_name=John Doe plus addressLine2=Fallback Line Two Systems GmbH and the sandbox will force addressLine2Fallback to win. FR44000000003 returns Primary Keeps Adresse SAS, 45 Avenue des Tests, 69002 Lyon, FR; send company_name=John Doe plus addressLine1=45 Avenue des Tests to observe fallback attempted with two score_attempts but score_source remaining companyName. IT44000000004 returns No Fallback Support SRL, Via Prova 9, 40121 Bologna, IT; send company_name=John Doe without helpful address lines to observe score_source=companyName and a single score_attempt. Extra deterministic score examples: ATU00000000(score=0, official provider valid), DE222222220(score=20), FR11223344556(score=60), IT55667788990(score=80).

VatResource.title: VAT Resource
VatResource.description: Response structure for a VAT request

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the VAT record

state.description: State of the VAT number (e.g., VALID, INVALID, NOT_FOUND)

country_code.description: Country code of the VAT registration

company_name.description: Registered company name for the VAT number

provider.description: Upstream provider used to process the VAT request when available

used_providers.description: Collection of upstream providers that participated in the validation run

valid_providers.description: Providers that explicitly reported the VAT as valid in this history snapshot.

invalid_providers.description: Providers that explicitly reported the VAT as invalid in this history snapshot.

provider_audit.description: Immutable per-provider audit snapshot captured for this history entry.

requested_company_name.description: Effective company-name candidate used for scoring. If addressLine1 fallback was selected, this equals addressLine1.

requested_company_name_original.description: Original company_name received from the API request.

requested_input_address.description: Normalized address input received from the API request.

checked_at.description: Timestamp of the last VAT check

environment.description: Environment where the VAT validation was executed (e.g. LIVE or SANDBOX)

score.description: Risk Score! 100 OK, 50 Could be fraud...

breakdown.description: Detailed breakdown of the score calculation

score_source.description: Source used for the final AI name score (companyName, addressLine1Fallback, or addressLine2Fallback).

score_attempts.description: Debug view of executed score attempts.

provider_valid.description: Official provider verdict for this response when available: true for valid, false for invalid, null when no official provider verdict could be determined.

provider_vat_state.description: Latest VAT state reported by the upstream provider when available

provider_note.description: Explanatory note included when the provider state differs from the validation result
provider_note.example: Provider reports VAT Number is valid, but the check failed (e.g., name/address mismatch).

provider_last_checked_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent upstream provider confirmation

has_api_error.description: True when at least one provider encountered a technical/API failure during the latest validation run.

error_message.description: Primary technical error message captured for the latest validation run when available.

next_api_recheck_at.description: Scheduled retry time when the latest validation result was preserved because official providers returned only API errors.

provider_document.description: Deprecated: use provider_documents instead. This field will be removed in the next API version. For history entries, the document is resolved via explicit history links and may exist without a provider request.

provider_documents.description: All linked provider documents (may include multiple providers/types). For history entries, links are created even when no provider request exists.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key required for all requests. Provide the key via the x-api-key header.
ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token returned by /v1/login. Use as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
